segments.title: 第141章 溪溪的紅包
segments.content:
Chapter 141: Xixi's Red Envelope

In the evening, on the way home.

Ying Chanxi pointed to a specialty store by the street and asked Li Luo, "The store where you bought the Polaroid, it should be this one, right?"

"Yeah."

"Then I'll go take a look."

"Huh?" Li Luo was stunned for a moment. "What are you going to look at?"

"I'm using up my photo paper a bit fast." Ying Chanxi said, a little embarrassed. "I feel it's better to have some extra on hand to be safe."

Hearing this, Li Luo didn't press further, just saying, "Then I'll head back first to make a late-night snack. You come back soon."

"I'll stay with Xixi," Xu Youyu, who was at her side, said.

So Li Luo went home first, while Xu Youyu accompanied Ying Chanxi into the specialty store.

While Ying Chanxi was pretending to inquire about buying photo paper, she glanced at Xu Youyu who was casually looking at the counter displays, then took out her own Polaroid and asked the clerk something.

A few minutes later, the two of them came out of the store and hurried home.

"Xixi, how did you feel this afternoon when Li Luo performed by himself?" Xu Youyu asked with a wide smile. "Having someone sing a song just for you, wasn't it quite touching?"

"It was... it was just okay, I guess..." Ying Chanxi said in a small voice. "It was a pleasant surprise."

"Just a surprise? I thought you'd be moved to tears."

"I don't cry that easily."

The two chatted idly, and Xu Youyu took the opportunity to gather some material.

After all, from her perspective, this kid Li Luo was a perfect source of material. It felt like he would stumble into any kind of suave scenario.

It was a shame that the main character of the book she was writing wasn't a campus character, so some of the material was unusable.

Otherwise, this move of singing to a girl in front of the whole school was just too perfect to write into a plot.

At this thought, Xu Youyu's hands were even starting to itch.

But Ying Chanxi was clearly somewhat distracted.

After Li Luo finished making the late-night snack and the three of them had eaten, Li Luo said, "You ran the 1500-meter today. Go wash up and get to bed early after eating. Rest well."

"Oh." Ying Chanxi nodded.

Xu Youyu, at the side, also took on the task of washing the dishes, letting Ying Chanxi go straight to take a shower.

After coming out of the shower, Ying Chanxi wrapped her damp hair in a towel. She first returned to her own bedroom, and after a little while, she came out and knocked on Li Luo's door.

At that moment, Li Luo had just switched his computer screen back to the desktop. He turned to look at Ying Chanxi who pushed the door open and came in, then naturally stood up, gave her his seat, and went to get the hair dryer.

"Li Luo." Sitting in the chair and enjoying Li Luo's hair-drying service, Ying Chanxi said with her eyes closed.

"Hm, what is it?"

"I want to tell you something."

"Go ahead."

"But I have to state in advance that I don't have any other intentions. I'm just purely a little worried."

"What's so serious?" Li Luo said with a laugh. "Just say it."

"Then before I say it, can you accept this first?" Ying Chanxi suddenly pulled a red envelope from her pajama pocket and handed it to Li Luo behind her.

"What's this for?" Li Luo was completely baffled. He took her red envelope and squeezed it, then opened it for a peek. He found a stack of red bills inside, at least 1,000 yuan. "Wait... are you trying to become my sugar mommy?"

"What are you talking about!" Ying Chanxi had her entire speech prepared, but Li Luo's words completely threw her off rhythm. She instantly stomped her foot, her face beet red.

Her fair, bare feet stepped on the floor, the still-damp soles instantly leaving wet prints on the wooden planks.

"Then why are you giving me money?" Li Luo looked exasperated. "Still saying you're not after my good looks?"

"Get lost!" Ying Chanxi puffed her cheeks, sulking. "Just what is going on in that head of yours? That's ridiculous!"

"Alright, alright." Li Luo stuffed the red envelope back into Ying Chanxi's pajama pocket, then said, "You were just speaking so seriously, I was trying to lighten the mood. Go on, what were you about to say?"

"It's just, it's just..." With his interruption, the mood Ying Chanxi had worked so hard to build up was suddenly broken, and for a moment she didn't know where to begin. "Where was I just now?"

"You said you were just purely a little worried, and that I shouldn't overthink it." Li Luo prompted. "So can you say it now? What's so serious."

"Aiya... it's about that Polaroid you gave me." Ying Chanxi said helplessly. "I went to their store tonight, right? And I asked."

"Mm, what did you ask?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow, seeming to have realized something.

"I asked about the price." Ying Chanxi shot Li Luo an annoyed glance. "The model you bought for me costs sixteen hundred yuan."

"And the clerk said that the photo paper included with the camera is only what's in the box. There's absolutely no such thing as an extra 100 sheets."

"Just that kind of photo paper costs thirty or forty yuan for a single pack of 10. You bought 100 sheets, so that's at least three or four hundred."

"Added together, the money you spent on the camera for me was at least two thousand yuan."

"Where did you get that much money?"

After hearing Ying Chanxi's words, Li Luo understood what she meant.

This was something he had slightly overlooked.

Earlier, he had just gone downstairs for a morning run, remembered on the way that Ying Chanxi was still angry, and happened to see such a store on the street, so he bought it on a whim, thinking it would be enough to calm her down.

After all, with an income of over ten thousand a month, a gift of one or two thousand like this was naturally something Li Luo could handle with ease.

But from Ying Chanxi's perspective, this gift from Li Luo was quite expensive.

It was rare for ordinary students to casually give away gifts worth over a thousand yuan.

Even for someone from a well-off family like Ying Chanxi, she wouldn't casually choose such a valuable gift for someone.

After all, whether one could afford it was one thing; whether the other party could accept it was another. It needed to be treated with care.

Thinking of this, Li Luo's gaze softened, and he gently stroked Ying Chanxi's head. "It must have been tough on you, thinking so much for my sake."

"What kind of thing is that to say..." Feeling the warm touch on her head, Ying Chanxi somewhat coveted this gentleness. She mumbled softly but showed no sign of resistance.

"But don't you worry too much either," Li Luo said. "Remember the school promotion banquet during the summer vacation?"

"I remember, what about it?"

"Didn't I receive a bunch of red envelopes then?" Li Luo said. "My mom only took half. She let me keep the other half as spending money. Plus, at the beginning of the summer vacation, my mom gave me fifteen hundred, and there was the money I got from my uncle for selling belts at the school gate."

"When you add it all up, it's actually quite a bit. It's not as difficult as you think."

"It's just buying a camera for you. You don't need to overthink it."

After hearing Li Luo's words, Ying Chanxi fell silent, thinking it over carefully, and finally asked, "Is everything you said true?"

"Of course."

"You didn't ask Uncle and Auntie for the money to buy the camera, did you?"

"Definitely not," Li Luo said, shaking his head. "We still have the mortgage to pay at home. As long as I have money on hand, there's no way I'd ask my parents for it."

"I-Is that so..." The worry that had been hanging in Ying Chanxi's heart finally settled.

But when she thought about Li Luo casually giving a two-thousand-yuan gift, she still took out the red envelope from her pocket. "There's 1500 yuan in here."

"I looked at the Polaroids in that shop. The cheapest model is just over five hundred."

"How about you take this red envelope, and we'll just pretend you bought me the five-hundred-yuan Polaroid. Would that be okay?"

Li Luo looked at Ying Chanxi and suddenly started laughing, tapping her on the head. "You're really something else, so silly."

"Ow... why did you hit me..." Ying Chanxi clutched her head and glared at him.

"You should do this kind of thing less in the future. It's too hurtful, but..." As he said this, Li Luo took the red envelope from Ying Chanxi's hand, pulled out a 100-yuan bill, and stuffed it into his own pants pocket.

Then he put the red envelope back in Ying Chanxi's pocket, the hundred-yuan bill pinched between his fingers, and said with a smile, "Forget the red envelope, but I can take this 100 yuan tip. Consider it a reward for drying your hair for free these past few months."

Since Li Luo had put it that way, Ying Chanxi didn't insist anymore.

After all, if he hadn't asked his uncle and auntie for the money to buy the camera, and it was his own saved-up allowance, Ying Chanxi was at least very happy in her heart, and she wouldn't have excessive worries.

At worst, when they eat at school in the future, she could just swipe her meal card for him more often.

With this thought, Ying Chanxi no longer insisted on giving the red envelope to Li Luo.

However, looking at the hundred-yuan bill in Li Luo's hand, Ying Chanxi thought for a moment, then pulled out another one hundred yuan from her red envelope, stuffed it into Li Luo's hand, propped her own foot up on the edge of the bed, and said with a cheerful grin:

"Then I'll give you another 100-yuan tip. How about you give me a shoulder and leg massage?"

(End of this chapter)
